about.title: About
about.block1Body: Neurica is EONYX's public experimental surface: prototypes, live demos, visual studies, case studies. A living lab, not a second production surface.
about.block2Body: EONYX runs three distinct surfaces. eonyx.net is the corporate site: company positioning, contact, commercial communication. Neurica shows how the company thinks and what it builds, without commercial weight. Product and client surfaces are real business systems with an SLA. Neurica can show their work as a case or a demo, but never is one: commercial data on this surface is never LIVE.
about.block3Body: Every object has two independent axes. Type — EXPERIMENT, PROTOTYPE, TOOL, CASE, VISUAL_STUDY, EDITORIAL — is what kind of work it is, and doesn't change. Status — LIVE, DEMO, STATIC, FROZEN, ARCHIVE — is its state right now, and does. LIVE means the object genuinely works and has an owner responsible for it staying up. DEMO means it's interactive on fixed or synthetic data, with no guarantees — and that warning sits next to the link, not in the metadata at the bottom of the page.
